verdict.rationale: Letta's documented memory model is text/file-based (Markdown memory blocks, MemFS repositories) rather than a knowledge graph of entities and relationships, and a Letta engineer explicitly describes memory as 'primarily text/files based' rather than graph-structured. No evidence of entity extraction, relationship modeling, or multi-hop graph traversal query capability is present in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: any documentation of graph schema/entities/relationships, multi-hop query support, or entity-centric retrieval.
